name: video-remembers
note: ROUND 16 (operator UAT 2026-09-02, verbatim: "don't auto hide yt video. I keep having to open it to skip after ads"). The law: the video's visibility is the USER'S, never the app's. A fresh device opens the video VISIBLE so a pre-roll ad's Skip button needs no tap; parking it once makes every LATER open parked (music.vidPref.v1 - additive key, no SCHEMA_VERSION bump), until the user shows it again. This is what keeps round 15's intent ("not show the video any other time") reachable without re-parking on every track. Red-first: against the pre-round-16 build step 2 fails, because every open was hardcoded to setVid('hid').

steps.label: FRESH DEVICE (no stored preference) -> the video opens VISIBLE, so the ad Skip surface is already on screen
and nothing has been written to the preference yet - restoring a default must not masquerade as a user choice
PARKING IS A USER ACT -> it is remembered ('hid'), and the player wears the parked class
THE NEXT OPEN HONORS IT - parked stays parked with no re-tap (round 15's quiet state, now owned by the user instead of hardcoded)
SHOWING IT AGAIN IS ALSO REMEMBERED - the preference flips back to theater, so the pendulum swings both ways
